find.description:
Exact label text. Repeat for OR. Ignore case and whitespace breaks. History also ignores hyphenation.
Current labels: two excerpts per section, up to five sections and five comma-separated SPL set IDs.
Only with section label or label-history.

input.description: Source ID or full brand or generic name (fda-dsc requires the communication UUID). Keep spaces in WHO references. Exact brands rank first. Drugs@FDA ranks NDA/BLA before ANDA, then earliest approval. EMA uses earliest authorisation. Others use search order. Replies show up to five alternatives and their total. Labels also take application numbers (e.g. NDA216340). Find that UUID with search drug NAME --source fda-dsc. Generic names accept one trailing salt or ester term: mesylate, hydrochloride, sodium, potassium, calcium, sulfate, maleate, tartrate, citrate, phosphate, acetate, besylate, fumarate, succinate, tosylate, bromide, chloride. Brands identical to their ingredient count as generic. USAN: https://www.ama-assn.org/about/united-states-adopted-names-usan/united-states-adopted-names-naming-guidelines
